Our Services Dr. Matthew Milana and his wonderful dental team provide Arcadia, Biltmore, and others areas of Phoenix with all the dental services you and your family need to enjoy a healthy and beautiful smile. We welcome patients of all ages to our dental office. Some of our services include: Dental Crowns Porcelain Veneers Emergency Care Invisalign® Dental Implants All Services Want to See Us This Week? Call Now Welcome to Arcadia Dentistry in Phoenix Whether you’re looking for a dentist in Arcadia or are new to Phoenix, we’re here to provide you with a comfortable dental experience. Our Arcadia dental office accepts a variety of insurance plans, offers early morning and evening hours , and works with your schedule to make dental care as convenient as possible. Located at 4214 E. Indian School Rd. Ste. 102 , we proudly serve patients of all ages in Arcadia, Camelback East, Biltmore, and beyond. Dentist Arcadia: Experienced and Dedicated Care Led by Dr. Matthew Milana, who has proudly served the Arcadia and Phoenix communities since 2006, our team is dedicated to providing state-of-the-art dental care in a welcoming and supportive environment. Dr. Milana's extensive experience, coupled with his family's rich history in dentistry, ensures a commitment to both the art and science of creating beautiful and healthy smiles. Dentistry Runs in Our Family Dr. Milana comes from a long line of dental professionals, including his grandfather, uncles, and father, who are also skilled dentists and dental lab technicians. Growing up in a dental lab, Dr. Milana gained firsthand experience in the artistry and precision of restoring smiles. Today, he’s proud to bring that same passion for Arcadia family dentistry to his patients. Our Comprehensive Dental Services We offer a wide range of services to keep your smile healthy and beautiful, including: Family Dentistry — Comprehensive care for families in Phoenix, from cleanings to restorative treatments. Cosmetic Dentistry Services — Enhance your confidence with expert cosmetic dentistry in Arcadia, including veneers and teeth whitening. Emergency Care — Same-day appointments are available to address urgent dental issues when you need us most. Invisalign® — Straighten your smile without the hassle of metal braces. Dental Implants — A permanent and natural-looking solution for missing teeth. Our goal is to provide care that fits seamlessly into your busy life while addressing all your dental concerns. Explore all our services, and let us help you achieve and maintain a smile you’ll love! Creating Your Personalized Smile Plan At your first visit, we’ll take the time to understand your needs, goals, and concerns. Dr. Milana will design a customized treatment plan, discuss options like Invisalign, cosmetic dentistry, or restorative care, and ensure you feel informed and confident. Our front desk team will also help you maximize your insurance benefits and explore payment options . We’re here to make every step of your dental journey seamless and stress-free. Call Your Trusted Dentist in Arcadia Today! Looking for a Phoenix family dentist, an Invisalign provider in Arcadia, or an emergency dentist in Phoenix? You’ve come to the right place. Arcadia Dentistry offers comprehensive care for every stage of life, from preventive exams to advanced treatments like dental implants. Do you offer early morning appointments? We sure do! At Arcadia Dentistry, we understand that life doesn’t always fit neatly around traditional office hours. That’s why, every Monday through Thursday, we offer early morning appointments (starting at 7:00 am) to better accommodate your busy schedule. For good measure, in trying to provide our patients with the greatest flexibility, we’re also open until 6:30 pm! Whether you’re a working professional, a parent managing school drop-offs, or someone who prefers to get things done before the day picks up steam—or if you’re more of an after-work type—we’ve got you covered! Early Mornings at Arcadia Dentistry Our early morning slots are particularly popular for routine cleanings, checkups, and other general dental care needs, with shorter wait times and a quieter, more relaxed environment. Our patients also love the convenience of attending to their oral health before heading to the office or tackling their to-do lists. As these time slots tend to fill up quickly, we recommend booking your early morning appointments in advance—just let us know your preference when scheduling, and we will do everything in our power to accommodate your schedule. Convenient, High-Quality Dental Care in Arcadia, AZ If you're looking for a local dentist in Arcadia who values your time as much as your smile, look no further than Arcadia Dentistry!
